babs.1: The saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: "Say: Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful …"
babs.2: What is mentioned about the Essence, the attributes and the names of Allah
babs.3: "And His Throne was upon the water"
babs.4: What is reported about the saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good"
babs.5: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits …"
babs.7: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "He sent it down with His knowledge, and the angels bear witness"
babs.8: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "They want to change the words of Allah"
babs.9: The speech of the Lord, Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Resurrection with the prophets and others
babs.10: His saying: "And Allah spoke to Musa with direct speech"
babs.11: The Lord's speech with the people of Paradise
babs.12: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And you were not concealing yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you …"
babs.13: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Every day He is in a matter"
babs.14: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Do not move your tongue with it"
babs.15: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And conceal your speech or publicize it …"
babs.16: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "O Messenger, convey that which has been revealed to you from your Lord …"
babs.17: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Say: Then bring the Torah and recite it"
babs.18: The Prophet ﷺ called the prayer a deed
babs.19: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Indeed, man was created anxious …"
babs.20: The Prophet's ﷺ mention and his narration from his Lord
babs.21: What is permissible of explaining the Torah and other books of Allah in Arabic
babs.22: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance"
babs.23: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "But it is a glorious Qur'an, in a preserved Tablet"
babs.24: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And Allah created you and what you do"
babs.25: The recitation of the wicked and the hypocrite, and their voices
